headlines.title: Europe frets as the Kremlin pushes the limits of its hybrid warfare
headlines.description: The Kremlin is testing Europe‘s limits.

headlines.title: Millions brace for rare fall nor’easter along the East Coast
headlines.description: Millions of people in the Northeast are bracing for a rare September nor’easter that’s bringing strong winds and heavy rain to the region. The powerful storm is expected to create dangerous conditions in parts of the East Coast through the weekend.

headlines.title: Hurricane Nolo expected to bring heavy rain as it skirts Hawaii’s Big Island
headlines.description: NAALEHU, Hawaii — Hurricane Nolo is forecast to strengthen into a major hurricane in the Pacific Ocean over the weekend and unleash intense rain, the possibility of life-threatening flash flooding and dangerous surf for Hawaii’s Big Island.

headlines.title: Some lawmakers doubt a Congress that’s ‘barely capable of email’ can regulate AI
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — Amid warnings that artificial intelligence could soon wipe out humanity, some lawmakers are not confident that Congress has the expertise or ability to regulate AI.

headlines.title: A federal agency is allegedly hacked, and an Olympic gymnast’s home is burglarized: The news quiz
headlines.description: Americans are drinking less, NFL quarterbacks are dropping like flies, and a roller coaster is allegedly causing serious brain trauma.

headlines.title: Trump says he has rejected Iranian proposal to reopen Strait of Hormuz
headlines.description: President Donald Trump said Saturday that he has rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, after Iranian officials indicated that shipping through the critical waterway could resume within days if a deal was sealed.

headlines.title: White House blocks CNN from covering Trump’s Tennessee trip
headlines.description: The White House on Friday night removed CNN from joining President Donald Trump on his trip to Tennessee on Saturday, where it was supposed to cover the president on behalf of major TV networks.

headlines.title: Supreme Court rejects Republicans’ Missouri redistricting push for third time
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — For the third time, the Supreme Court on Friday shut down efforts by Missouri Republicans to use a new congressional map in the midterm elections that are already underway.

headlines.title: Should you bring iced coffee to a job interview? Question brews generational debate
headlines.description: What started as a conversation about job interview tips online escalated into a generational debate over whether it’s taboo to show up with an iced coffee to talk to a potential employer.

headlines.title: New data shows most women in the Marines passing toughened fitness tests for combat roles
headlines.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said he wanted women in combat roles to be held to the same physical standards as men. One year later, new numbers from the Marine Corps show most women in combat roles are meeting, or exceeding those standards. NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian reports.

headlines.title: Neighbor charged with murder after Georgia DoorDash driver found dismembered
headlines.description: A woman’s dismembered remains were found in garbage bags at an apartment complex in Georgia, police said Friday.

headlines.title: Ohio college janitor hid in ceiling above locker room to photograph women’s soccer team, police say
headlines.description: A janitor at Wilmington College in Ohio was arrested Tuesday for hiding in the ceiling above a locker room to photograph the women’s soccer team as they changed, police said.
